responsibility: Defines RTL patterns for the short-forward-branch optimization facility used on RISC-V targets that can profitably implement conditional moves via tiny forward branches. It provides `movcc`-style instruction patterns and splits that transform masked-bit idioms into branch-plus-move/constant sequences with the `sfb_alu` type, supporting code generation and scheduling models that recognize these short forward branch forms separately from Zicond-based conditional zeroing.
